name: Nav
label: Nav
description: A legacy plain top bar of brand and page links, superseded by the site header and kept for existing consumers.

props.name: buttons
props.description: Navigation buttons config — passed directly to ButtonGroup

props.name: trailing
props.description: Additional elements rendered after the button group (e.g. ToggleSwitch)

ButtonGroupOwnProps.description: Props owned by ButtonGroup itself — everything else falls through to the group `<div>`.

ButtonOwnProps.description: Props owned by Button itself — everything else falls through to the DOM node.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.
